// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © LuxAlgo
//@version=6
strategy("Gold/DXY Reversal Strategy V6", shorttitle="Gold DXY Rev V6", overlay=true, initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.cash, default_qty_value=1000, max_boxes_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// --- Constants ---
const string GRP_TREND = "Trend Filters"
const string GRP_CORR  = "Correlation & Sensitivity"
const string GRP_RISK  = "Risk Management"
const string GRP_EMA_X = "EMA Mitigation Exit"
const string GRP_HOLD  = "Extended Hold Exit (Profit)"
const string GRP_DASH  = "Dashboard & Visuals"
const string GRP_RR    = "Risk/Reward Visual Tool"
const string GRP_SESS  = "Session Filter"
const string GRP_OB    = "Order Block Override"
const string GRP_TIME  = "Time-Based Exit"
const string GRP_PL    = "Profit/Loss Exits ($, %)"

color BULL_COLOR = #089981
color BEAR_COLOR = #f23645
color NEUT_COLOR = #5b9cf6

// --- Inputs ---
// Session Filter
useSession = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter", group=GRP_SESS)
sessionTime = input.session("0000-2359", "Trading Session (UTC)", group=GRP_SESS)

// Trend Filters
useSupertrend = input.bool(false, "Use Supertrend Filter", group=GRP_TREND)
stMult = input.float(3.0, "Supertrend Multiplier", minval=0.1, group=GRP_TREND)
stLen  = input.int(10, "Supertrend Period", minval=1, group=GRP_TREND)

useRibbon = input.bool(false, "Use EMA Ribbon Filter", group=GRP_TREND)
ema1Len = input.int(20, "EMA 1", group=GRP_TREND)
ema2Len = input.int(50, "EMA 2", group=GRP_TREND)

// Correlation & Overextension
useDxyFilter = input.bool(true, "Use DXY Correlation Filter", group=GRP_CORR)
dxySymbol = input.symbol("TVC:DXY", "DXY Symbol", group=GRP_CORR)
goldSymbol = input.symbol("PEPPERSTONE:XAUUSD", "Gold Symbol", group=GRP_CORR)
lookback  = input.int(5, "Overextension Lookback (Bars)", minval=1, group=GRP_CORR)
overextThreshold = input.float(0.01, "Overextension % Threshold", minval=0.0, step=0.001, group=GRP_CORR)

// NEW: Correlation Sharp Move Options
enableCorrSame = input.bool(false, "Correlation: Same Direction Follow", group=GRP_CORR, tooltip="If Gold and DXY move sharply same direction, trade in that direction")
enableCorrOpp  = input.bool(false, "Correlation: Same Direction Reverse", group=GRP_CORR, tooltip="If Gold and DXY move sharply same direction, trade in opposite direction")
corrLookback   = input.int(5, "Corr Lookback", minval=1, group=GRP_CORR)
corrThreshold  = input.float(0.1, "Corr Sharp Move %", minval=0.0, step=0.01, group=GRP_CORR)

// NEW: Order Block Override
obTfInput       = input.timeframe("60", "OB Timeframe", group=GRP_OB)
obOverrideInput = input.bool(false, "Bypass Filters in OB Zone", group=GRP_OB, tooltip="If true, any buy/sell signal within the HTF OB range will execute regardless of trend filters.")

// NEW: Time Exit
useTimeExit     = input.bool(true, "Use Close by Time", group=GRP_TIME)
closeTimeInput  = input.string("1605", "Close Time (HHMM)", group=GRP_TIME, tooltip="Time to close all trades (4:05 PM is 1605)")
timezoneInput   = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", group=GRP_TIME)

// NEW: Profit/Loss Exits
profitDollar    = input.float(0.0, "Profit Target ($)", group=GRP_PL, tooltip="Close if profit exceeds this amount. 0 to disable.")
lossDollar      = input.float(0.0, "Stop Loss ($)", group=GRP_PL, tooltip="Close if loss exceeds this amount. 0 to disable.")
profitPctTarget = input.float(0.0, "Profit Target (%)", group=GRP_PL, tooltip="Close if profit % exceeds this. 0 to disable.")
lossPctTarget   = input.float(0.0, "Stop Loss (%)", group=GRP_PL, tooltip="Close if loss % exceeds this. 0 to disable.")

// Risk Management
qtyMode = input.string("Risk %", "Quantity Type", options=["Risk %", "Fixed"], group=GRP_RISK, tooltip="Choose between dynamic risk-based sizing or a fixed contract amount.")
riskPct = input.float(1.0, "Risk Per Trade (%)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK, tooltip="Strategy will risk 1% of total equity per trade if 'Risk %' is selected.")
fixedQty = input.float(1.0, "Fixed Contract Size", minval=0.01, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK, tooltip="Specify the number of contracts/lots to trade if 'Fixed' is selected.")
rrRatio = input.float(1.0, "Risk:Reward Ratio (Final)", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK)
slLookback = input.int(10, "Stop Loss Swing Lookback", minval=2, group=GRP_RISK)
atrBufferMult = input.float(1.5, "ATR Stop Buffer Multiplier", minval=0.0, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK)

// Multiple Take Profits
useMultipleTps = input.bool(false, "Use Multiple Take Profits", group=GRP_RISK)
tp1Ratio = input.float(0.5, "TP 1 RR Ratio", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK, inline="tp1")
tp1Qty   = input.float(33.0, "TP 1 Qty %", minval=1, maxval=100, step=1, group=GRP_RISK, inline="tp1")
tp2Ratio = input.float(1.0, "TP 2 RR Ratio", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK, inline="tp2")
tp2Qty   = input.float(33.0, "TP 2 Qty %", minval=1, maxval=100, step=1, group=GRP_RISK, inline="tp2")
tp3Ratio = input.float(1.5, "TP 3 RR Ratio", minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=GRP_RISK, inline="tp3")
tp3Qty   = input.float(34.0, "TP 3 Qty %", minval=1, maxval=100, step=1, group=GRP_RISK, inline="tp3")

// EMA Mitigation Exit (Loss Mitigation)
useEmaExit = input.bool(false, "Use EMA Mitigation Exit", group=GRP_EMA_X, tooltip="Closes the trade if price crosses the EMA while the trade is currently in a loss.")
exitEmaLen = input.int(20, "Exit EMA Length", minval=1, group=GRP_EMA_X, tooltip="Specific EMA period used for the loss mitigation exit.")
exitTrendTf = input.timeframe("D", "Trend Timeframe", group=GRP_EMA_X, tooltip="Timeframe used to determine the major trend for mitigation purposes.")
exitTrendLen = input.int(200, "Trend EMA Length", group=GRP_EMA_X, tooltip="EMA length on the higher timeframe used to identify the trend.")
ignoreMitAfterWin = input.bool(true, "Ignore Mitigation if Prev. Trade was Same & Won", group=GRP_EMA_X, tooltip="If the previous trade was in the same direction and closed in profit, the EMA mitigation exit will be disabled for the current trade.")

// Extended Hold Exit (Profit Taking)
useHoldExit = input.bool(false, "Use Extended Hold Exit", group=GRP_HOLD, tooltip="Exits a winning trade if a candle closes opposite the position and beyond the Hold EMA.")
holdEmaLen = input.int(50, "Hold EMA Length", minval=1, group=GRP_HOLD, tooltip="EMA period used for the profit-taking exit logic.")
holdTrendTf = input.timeframe("D", "Hold Trend Timeframe", group=GRP_HOLD, tooltip="Timeframe used to determine the major trend for the Extended Hold Exit.")
holdTrendLen = input.int(200, "Hold Trend EMA Length", group=GRP_HOLD, tooltip="EMA length on the higher timeframe used to identify the trend for holding profits.")
holdOnlyCounterTrend = input.bool(false, "Only Apply to Counter-Trend Wins", group=GRP_HOLD, tooltip="If enabled, this exit criteria only applies to winning trades that are currently against the specified Hold Trend Timeframe.")

// Visuals
showDash = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard", group=GRP_DASH)

// RR Visual Tool
showRrTool = input.bool(true, "Show RR Visual Tool", group=GRP_RR)
slColor    = input.color(color.new(#f23645, 80), "SL Color", group=GRP_RR)
tpColor    = input.color(color.new(#089981, 80), "TP Color", group=GRP_RR)

// --- Calculations ---

// 1. Session Logic
bool inSession = not useSession or not na(time(timeframe.period, sessionTime, "UTC"))

// 2. Trend Filters
[stValue, stDirection] = ta.supertrend(stMult, stLen)
ema1 = ta.ema(close, ema1Len)
ema2 = ta.ema(close, ema2Len)
exitEma = ta.ema(close, exitEmaLen)
holdEma = ta.ema(close, holdEmaLen)

bool trendLong = (not useSupertrend or stDirection < 0) and (not useRibbon or (ema1 > ema2))
bool trendShort = (not useSupertrend or stDirection > 0) and (not useRibbon or (ema1 < ema2))

// Higher Timeframe Trend for Mitigation Exit
float htfEmaMit = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, exitTrendTf, ta.ema(close, exitTrendLen))
float htfCloseMit = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, exitTrendTf, close)
bool htfTrendBullishMit = htfCloseMit > htfEmaMit
bool htfTrendBearishMit = htfCloseMit < htfEmaMit

// Higher Timeframe Trend for Hold Exit
float htfEmaHold = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, holdTrendTf, ta.ema(close, holdTrendLen))
float htfCloseHold = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, holdTrendTf, close)
bool htfTrendBullishHold = htfCloseHold > htfEmaHold
bool htfTrendBearishHold = htfCloseHold < htfEmaHold

// 3. Correlation Data
dxyClose = request.security(dxySymbol, timeframe.period, close, gaps=barmerge.gaps_off)
goldClose = request.security(goldSymbol, timeframe.period, close, gaps=barmerge.gaps_off)
dxyOpenRef = dxyClose[lookback]
goldOpenRef = goldClose[lookback]

// 4. Overextension Logic
float goldMovePct = math.abs((goldClose - goldOpenRef) / goldOpenRef * 100)
bool goldOverextended = goldMovePct >= overextThreshold
bool dxyConfirms = not useDxyFilter or (math.sign(goldClose - goldOpenRef) != math.sign(dxyClose - dxyOpenRef))

// NEW: Sharp Move Correlation Logic
goldChangeCorr = (goldClose - goldClose[corrLookback]) / goldClose[corrLookback] * 100
dxyChangeCorr  = (dxyClose - dxyClose[corrLookback]) / dxyClose[corrLookback] * 100
bothSharpUp    = goldChangeCorr >= corrThreshold and dxyChangeCorr >= corrThreshold
bothSharpDown  = goldChangeCorr <= -corrThreshold and dxyChangeCorr <= -corrThreshold

bool corrLong  = (enableCorrSame and bothSharpUp) or (enableCorrOpp and bothSharpDown)
bool corrShort = (enableCorrSame and bothSharpDown) or (enableCorrOpp and bothSharpUp)

// NEW: Order Block Zone (HTF Range)
[obHigh, obLow] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, obTfInput, [high, low])
bool inObZone = close <= obHigh and close >= obLow

// 5. Market Structure Shift (MSS)
float mssHigh = ta.highest(high, 3)[1]
float mssLow  = ta.lowest(low, 3)[1]

bool mssBullish = ta.crossover(close, mssHigh)
bool mssBearish = ta.crossunder(close, mssLow)

// 6. Stop Loss Logic
float atr = ta.atr(14)
float longSl  = ta.lowest(low, slLookback)[1] - (atr * atrBufferMult)
float shortSl = ta.highest(high, slLookback)[1] + (atr * atrBufferMult)

// --- Strategy Execution ---

var float entryPrice = na
var float slLevel = na
var float tpLevel = na
var float tp1Level = na
var float tp2Level = na
var float tp3Level = na
var int entryBar = na
var bool isLong = false
var int mitigationExits = 0
var int holdExits = 0

// RR Visual Objects
var box slBox = na
var box tpBox = na
var line entryLine = na

// Risk Amount
float riskAmount = strategy.equity * (riskPct / 100)

// Entry Conditions
baseLong = goldOverextended and dxyConfirms and goldClose < goldOpenRef and mssBullish
baseShort = goldOverextended and dxyConfirms and goldClose > goldOpenRef and mssBearish

// Apply Trend Filters OR OB Override
longFilter = obOverrideInput and inObZone ? true : trendLong
shortFilter = obOverrideInput and inObZone ? true : trendShort

bool longCondition = inSession and ((baseLong and longFilter) or corrLong)
bool shortCondition = inSession and ((baseShort and shortFilter) or corrShort)

// Long Entry
if longCondition and strategy.position_size == 0
    slLevel := longSl
    float slDist = close - slLevel
    if slDist > 0
        float contractQty = qtyMode == "Risk %" ? riskAmount / (slDist * syminfo.pointvalue) : fixedQty
        tpLevel  := close + (slDist * rrRatio)
        tp1Level := close + (slDist * tp1Ratio)
        tp2Level := close + (slDist * tp2Ratio)
        tp3Level := close + (slDist * tp3Ratio)
        entryPrice := close
        entryBar := bar_index
        isLong := true
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=contractQty, comment="Buy")
        
        if useMultipleTps
            float q1 = (contractQty * tp1Qty) / 100
            float q2 = (contractQty * tp2Qty) / 100
            strategy.exit("TP1", "Long", qty=q1, limit=tp1Level, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP1", comment_loss="SL")
            strategy.exit("TP2", "Long", qty=q2, limit=tp2Level, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP2", comment_loss="SL")
            strategy.exit("TP3", "Long", limit=tp3Level, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP3", comment_loss="SL")
        else
            strategy.exit("Exit Long", "Long", stop=slLevel, limit=tpLevel, comment_loss="SL", comment_profit="TP")
        
        if showRrTool
            slBox := box.new(entryBar, slLevel, entryBar, entryPrice, bgcolor=slColor, border_style=line.style_solid, border_color=color.new(slColor, 30))
            tpBox := box.new(entryBar, entryPrice, entryBar, useMultipleTps ? tp3Level : tpLevel, bgcolor=tpColor, border_style=line.style_solid, border_color=color.new(tpColor, 30))
            entryLine := line.new(entryBar, entryPrice, entryBar, entryPrice, color=chart.fg_color, style=line.style_dashed)
        
        alert("Buy Signal Triggered at " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// Short Entry
if shortCondition and strategy.position_size == 0
    slLevel := shortSl
    float slDist = slLevel - close
    if slDist > 0
        float contractQty = qtyMode == "Risk %" ? riskAmount / (slDist * syminfo.pointvalue) : fixedQty
        tpLevel  := close - (slDist * rrRatio)
        tp1Level := close - (slDist * tp1Ratio)
        tp2Level := close - (slDist * tp2Ratio)
        tp3Level := close - (slDist * tp3Ratio)
        entryPrice := close
        entryBar := bar_index
        isLong := false
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=contractQty, comment="Sell")
        
        if useMultipleTps
            float q1 = (contractQty * tp1Qty) / 100
            float q2 = (contractQty * tp2Qty) / 100
            strategy.exit("TP1", "Short", qty=q1, limit=tp1Level, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP1", comment_loss="SL")
            strategy.exit("TP2", "Short", qty=q2, limit=tp2Level, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP2", comment_loss="SL")
            strategy.exit("TP3", "Short", limit=tp3Level, stop=slLevel, comment_profit="TP3", comment_loss="SL")
        else
            strategy.exit("Exit Short", "Short", stop=slLevel, limit=tpLevel, comment_loss="SL", comment_profit="TP")
            
        if showRrTool
            slBox := box.new(entryBar, slLevel, entryBar, entryPrice, bgcolor=slColor, border_style=line.style_solid, border_color=color.new(slColor, 30))
            tpBox := box.new(entryBar, entryPrice, entryBar, useMultipleTps ? tp3Level : tpLevel, bgcolor=tpColor, border_style=line.style_solid, border_color=color.new(tpColor, 30))
            entryLine := line.new(entryBar, entryPrice, entryBar, entryPrice, color=chart.fg_color, style=line.style_dashed)
            
        alert("Sell Signal Triggered at " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

// Update/Finalize RR Visuals
if showRrTool and strategy.position_size != 0
    box.set_right(slBox, bar_index)
    box.set_right(tpBox, bar_index)
    line.set_x2(entryLine, bar_index)

// When trade closes, finalize the right edge
if showRrTool and strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0
    box.set_right(slBox, bar_index)
    box.set_right(tpBox, bar_index)
    line.set_x2(entryLine, bar_index)

// --- Exit Logic Constants ---
bool isAgainstMitTrend = (strategy.position_size > 0 and htfTrendBearishMit) or (strategy.position_size < 0 and htfTrendBullishMit)
bool isAgainstHoldTrend = (strategy.position_size > 0 and htfTrendBearishHold) or (strategy.position_size < 0 and htfTrendBullishHold)
bool isRedCandle = close < open
bool isGreenCandle = close > open


// --- EMA Mitigation Exit Logic (Loss Mitigation) ---
bool emaCrossUnderExit = ta.crossunder(close, exitEma)
bool emaCrossOverExit  = ta.crossover(close, exitEma)

// Determine if last trade was same direction and a win
bool lastWasWin = strategy.closedtrades > 0 and strategy.closedtrades.profit(strategy.closedtrades - 1) > 0
bool lastWasLong = strategy.closedtrades > 0 and strategy.closedtrades.size(strategy.closedtrades - 1) > 0
bool lastWasShort = strategy.closedtrades > 0 and strategy.closedtrades.size(strategy.closedtrades - 1) < 0

bool ignoreMitigation = ignoreMitAfterWin and ((strategy.position_size > 0 and lastWasLong and lastWasWin) or (strategy.position_size < 0 and lastWasShort and lastWasWin))

if useEmaExit and strategy.position_size > 0 and close < strategy.position_avg_price and emaCrossUnderExit and isAgainstMitTrend and not ignoreMitigation
    strategy.close("Long", comment="EMA Mitigation")
    alert("EMA Mitigation Exit (Long) at " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    mitigationExits += 1

if useEmaExit and strategy.position_size < 0 and close > strategy.position_avg_price and emaCrossOverExit and isAgainstMitTrend and not ignoreMitigation
    strategy.close("Short", comment="EMA Mitigation")
    alert("EMA Mitigation Exit (Short) at " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    mitigationExits += 1

// --- Extended Hold Exit Logic (Profit Taking) ---
bool holdExitLong = useHoldExit and strategy.position_size > 0 and close > strategy.position_avg_price and isRedCandle and close < holdEma and (not holdOnlyCounterTrend or isAgainstHoldTrend)
bool holdExitShort = useHoldExit and strategy.position_size < 0 and close < strategy.position_avg_price and isGreenCandle and close > holdEma and (not holdOnlyCounterTrend or isAgainstHoldTrend)

if holdExitLong
    strategy.close("Long", comment="Hold Exit (Profit)")
    alert("Extended Hold Exit (Long) at " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    holdExits += 1

if holdExitShort
    strategy.close("Short", comment="Hold Exit (Profit)")
    alert("Extended Hold Exit (Short) at " + str.tostring(close), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
    holdExits += 1

// NEW: Close by Time
targetHour   = math.floor(str.tonumber(closeTimeInput) / 100)
targetMinute = str.tonumber(closeTimeInput) % 100
timeToClose  = useTimeExit and hour(time, timezoneInput) == targetHour and minute(time, timezoneInput) == targetMinute

if timeToClose
    strategy.close_all(comment = "Close by Time")
    if strategy.position_size != 0
        holdExits += 1

// NEW: Profit/Loss Exits ($, %)
if strategy.position_size != 0
    pnl = strategy.openprofit
    pnlPct = (pnl / strategy.equity) * 100
    
    // Dollar Target/SL
    if profitDollar > 0 and pnl >= profitDollar
        strategy.close_all(comment = "Profit Target $")
        mitigationExits += 1
    if lossDollar > 0 and pnl <= -lossDollar
        strategy.close_all(comment = "Stop Loss $")
        mitigationExits += 1
        
    // Percentage Target/SL
    if profitPctTarget > 0 and pnlPct >= profitPctTarget
        strategy.close_all(comment = "Profit Target %")
        mitigationExits += 1
    if lossPctTarget > 0 and pnlPct <= -lossPctTarget
        strategy.close_all(comment = "Stop Loss %")
        mitigationExits += 1

// --- Visuals ---
plot(ema1, color=color.new(BULL_COLOR, 80), title="EMA 1")
plot(ema2, color=color.new(BEAR_COLOR, 80), title="EMA 2")
plot(useEmaExit ? exitEma : na, color=color.new(NEUT_COLOR, 50), style=plot.style_linebr, title="Exit EMA (Mitigation)")
plot(useHoldExit ? holdEma : na, color=color.new(color.orange, 50), style=plot.style_linebr, title="Hold EMA (Profit)")
plotshape(longCondition, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, BULL_COLOR, size=size.small, text="BUY")
plotshape(shortCondition, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, BEAR_COLOR, size=size.small, text="SELL")

// OB Zone Highlight
bgcolor(inObZone ? color.new(color.gray, 90) : na, title = "HTF OB Zone")

// --- Dashboard ---
var table statsTable = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 11, bgcolor=color.new(chart.bg_color, 10), border_width=1, border_color=chart.fg_color)

if showDash and barstate.islast
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 0, "Strategy Stats", bgcolor=color.new(NEUT_COLOR, 50), text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 0, "", bgcolor=color.new(NEUT_COLOR, 50))
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 1, "Total Trades", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 1, str.tostring(strategy.closedtrades), text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 2, "Win Rate", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 2, str.tostring(math.round(strategy.wintrades / math.max(1, strategy.closedtrades) * 100, 2)) + "%", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 3, "Net Profit", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 3, str.tostring(math.round(strategy.netprofit, 2)), text_color=strategy.netprofit >= 0 ? BULL_COLOR : BEAR_COLOR)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 4, "Mitigation Exits", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 4, str.tostring(mitigationExits), text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 5, "Hold Exits", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 5, str.tostring(holdExits), text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 6, "DXY Move %", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 6, str.tostring(math.round(math.abs((dxyClose - dxyOpenRef)/dxyOpenRef*100), 3)) + "%", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 7, "Gold Move %", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 7, str.tostring(math.round(goldMovePct, 3)) + "%", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 8, "In Session", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 8, inSession ? "Yes" : "No", text_color=inSession ? BULL_COLOR : BEAR_COLOR)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 9, "Equity", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 9, str.tostring(math.round(strategy.equity, 2)), text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 10, "Drawdown", text_color=chart.fg_color)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 10, str.tostring(math.round(strategy.max_drawdown, 2)), text_color=BEAR_COLOR)
